opening.argument: The presentation markets OneCoin as a rapidly growing network-marketing company and structures participation around business activity and team building. It advertises a “direct salesale bonus,” “Fast Start” and “Matching bonus,” presenting recruitment-linked compensation as part of the earning plan. It then claims that “OneCoin is highly profitable with and without team-building” and urges viewers to join and register through its website. Framing the token as an especially interesting investment because it is at an early stage, while pairing that opportunity with direct-sales and multi-level matching rewards, encourages participation through profitability and recruitment claims rather than a critical examination of the offer.
